definitions.explanation: A level or stage reached, used mainly in set phrases such as 〜の{域|いき}を{出|で}ない (to go no further than ~) and 〜の{域|いき}に{達|たっ}する (to reach the level of ~).

examples.japanese: ⟦{推測|すいそく}→推測：12821_suisoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: It's no more than a guess.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}している→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: His cooking has reached a professional level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Even after all my practice, I think my piano playing is still no more than a hobby.

notes:
Almost always after ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. In compounds it means an area or zone: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (region), ⟦{領域|りょういき}→領域：05459_ryouiki⟧ (domain), ⟦{流域|りゅういき}→流域：19664_ryuuiki⟧ (river basin), ⟦{音域|おんいき}→音域：21730_oniki⟧ (vocal range).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go no further than ~, to be no more than ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the level of ~
- ⟦{素人|しろうと}→素人：04270_shirouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧: to be still at an amateur level
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}: a godlike level of skill

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧ (breath) or ⟦{粋|いき}→粋：13773_iki⟧ (chic), which are read the same.
